title: text privacy

📱 Text Message Privacy Terms (via Textedly)

By subscribing to our text message list, you agree to the following terms:

1. What You’re Signing Up For

When you opt in, you’ll receive occasional SMS alerts from us via Textedly, including:

  • New content alerts (podcasts, YouTube shows, livestreams, meetups, support)
  • Important updates or announcements
  • Exclusive offers or behind-the-scenes info

We promise not to spam you, and we’ll keep it relevant and respectful.

2. What Data We Collect

We only collect:

  • Your mobile phone number
  • (Optional) Your name, if you provide it

We do not collect or share any other personal data through this service.

3. How We Use Your Info

Your number is used only to send you messages you’ve opted in to receive. Your data is securely stored and handled through Textedly, our SMS platform provider, and will never be sold or shared with third parties for marketing.

4. Your Consent

By subscribing, you:

  • Confirm that you are at least 13 years old
  • Consent to receive automated marketing and informational texts from us via Textedly
  • Understand that message frequency varies and that standard message and data rates may apply

No purchase is required to subscribe.

5. How to Unsubscribe

To opt out at any time, simply reply STOP to any text message we send. You will be immediately removed from our list.

Need help? You can also reply HELP to get support or contact us directly at:

📧 CanaryCryRadio@gmail.com
📬 Canary Cry Radio (or News Talk) P.O. BOX 32, Bonsall, CA 92003

To resubscribe: Text “UNSTOP CANARY” to 877-740-3226

6. Third-Party Compliance

All messages are sent using Textedly, a third-party platform fully compliant with the Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA) and other relevant privacy laws. Your information is never used by Textedly for their own marketing purposes.
